coverage.finding: The pencil folio label '207' with a superscript 'b' and a following point is in the top-left corner at about [365,315,150,110], as the native tile shows. The record's literal text and its annotation about the superscript and point match the source.

The one-line ink note sits at about [1690,1170,1140,100] and reads approximately '?by Kṛṣṇānanda: not traceable in Oxf. 149.' The leading query mark and the final point are visible. The cursive name, its diacritics and the abbreviation 'Oxf.' are rightly kept as approximate. No entry on this page sits next to it.

The faint pencil note sits at about [2789,3556,265,85]. It reads 'ā' (with a macron above), a query mark, then 'o' with a small circumflex-like stroke above, then a query mark. The record's literal text, its annotation of the circumflex-like stroke and its uncertain attachment all fit the source.

The faint pencil note sits at about [3044,3806,200,125]. It reads 'ā' with a macron, a long slash, a query mark, a gap, and then a second '?' at about x 3224. That second mark lies just right of the gutter fold (about x 3200). The fol. 208 overview's left strip shows the same group, which supports placing it on this leaf. The record is consistent with the source.

The fields.author value is a cursive, approximate reading that the note itself queries.
